All-Round Neck Support – Designed to cradle your neck from all angles, the Frido Travel Neck Pillow offers enhanced side and chin support to minimize neck movement, keeping your head comfortably in place even during upright sleeping. This innovative design prevents neck strain, reduces unwanted head bobbing, and lets you drift off without worry, whether you’re on a flight, bus, train, or long car ride.

Premium Comfort with Premium Support – Meticulously contoured to fit different neck profiles, this pillow ensures proper alignment of your neck and spine, so you arrive refreshed and free from neck aches. The plush, skin-friendly imported velvet cover feels soft against your skin and allows for breathable comfort, making each journey feel like a cozy rest stop, no matter the distance.

Adjustable, Portable & Easy to Clean – Equipped with a secure Velcro strap for customized fit, the Frido Travel Neck Pillow adapts to your comfort level. Its compact, portable design and all-way stretchable fabric allow for easy packing, while the removable, washable outer cover ensures freshness with every trip. Ideal for frequent travelers who refuse to compromise on comfort or convenience.

Your travel buddy needs a little care too—here’s how to keep it fresh for every journey: – The removable cover can be machine washed on a cold, gentle cycle. – Stick to mild detergent and air dry to keep it soft and cozy. – The memory foam core is not washable—if needed, spot clean with a damp cloth and let it dry completely before use. – Store it in the included pouch when not in use to keep it clean and travel-ready.
